rows.title: Typed amounts in exact cents
rows.defect: the cents digit is not padded, so "$45.5" is $45.05

rows.title: Real calendar days only
rows.defect: the round-trip check is dropped, so Feb 29, 2026 (read as Mar 1) passes

rows.title: The handoff link is plain https
rows.defect: the https check is dropped
rows.test: an http biller link is refused

rows.title: A real currency, as written
rows.defect: the currency is cut to three letters before it is checked (the bug found building this packet)

rows.title: Whole non-negative cents
rows.defect: any finite number counts as cents, so fractions pass

rows.title: A stopped agent proposes nothing
rows.defect: only an explicit stop blocks, so an unread setting lets the plan through

rows.title: Money owed to you is never paid out
rows.defect: the receivable check is dropped

rows.title: Unconfirmed bills are reviewed first
rows.defect: an asserted (unconfirmed) bill counts as payable
rows.test: an asserted bill is not paid

rows.title: Missing details are asked by name
rows.defect: only a missing amount is checked, so a bill with no due date goes on
rows.test: no due date is asked for

rows.title: A bill with a sync error is stale
rows.defect: the sync error is ignored

rows.title: 48 hours, not more
rows.defect: the default age is 72 hours
rows.test: 48 hours and a second is stale

rows.title: A stale $0 is not nothing due
rows.defect: the $0 check comes before the freshness check (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a two-week-old $0 asks for a refresh

rows.title: An applied payment stops a second
rows.defect: only a payment on the same revision counts

rows.title: An unknown result is in flight
rows.defect: "unknown" is left out of the in-flight states
rows.test: an unknown attempt is waited on

rows.title: Unknown autopay is asked
rows.defect: unknown autopay is treated as off

rows.title: Only an idempotent connection pays
rows.defect: the idempotency requirement is dropped
rows.test: a non-idempotent adapter is no route

rows.title: Exact account and invoice
rows.defect: either the account or the invoice is taken as enough

rows.title: The person's own account
rows.defect: ownership is not checked
rows.test: an account they don't own is refused

rows.title: Overdrawn is short, not stale
rows.defect: a negative balance is read as missing (the bug found building this packet)

rows.title: The fee counts against the buffer
rows.defect: the fee is left out of what remains

rows.title: Exactly the buffer is allowed
rows.defect: leaving exactly the buffer is refused

rows.title: Unknown coverage is asked
rows.defect: only an explicit false counts as incomplete

rows.title: The proposal lapses in 15 minutes
rows.defect: the proposal lives an hour

rows.title: A yes before the lapse only
rows.defect: the lapse is not checked

rows.title: Settled only in full
rows.defect: any applied payment settles the bill

rows.title: Only the matching invoice's event
rows.defect: the invoice reference is not compared
rows.test: an event for September's invoice changes nothing
